name: CSO_CASE_LINK_CONTENT
description: Holds the many to many relationship of CaseLink and Content. This table holds the assignment of a Case Link to a content record and the timestamp.

columns.name: CASELINK_ID
columns.description: The recordid of a CaseLink record.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: The recordid of the Content record assigned.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: When the content was linked to this case number.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime of the modification of this record.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the Unique recordid for this record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user associated with this record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user associated with this record.
